name: ai-live-translator
description: A bilingual text interpreter for AI agents. Translate ordinary user messages without answering them; use explicit direct address for agent commands.

interface.shortDescription: Translate messages between two languages without answering them.
interface.longDescription: Activate a two-way text interpreter, choose any two languages, and get only natural translations of ordinary messages. Setup recommends clear standard-language phrasing, explains an optional cue for identifying the text to translate, and describes ChatGPT's written or voice-message workflow plus Voice Advanced. Explicit direct address lets you control the agent, pause, or change languages.
defaultPrompt: Start AI Live Translator and ask me which two languages to use.
ابدأ المترجم الحي واسألني عن اللغتين.
